'''Majordomo''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] owned by [[Iaclyn Stark]].

==History==
In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], Iaclyn used Majordomo to spy on her [[Elli Stark|sister]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Jahan Cross]]. When the droid informed him that Elli and Cross had accessed his room at the [[Stark Compound]] and were breaking into his personal files, he ordered it to immobilize his sister and [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Imperial agent. The droid attacked, knocking Elli to the ground, but was eventually destroyed by Cross.
